popup.education.campusNote: Campus boundaries come from official map data; no data for Penghu or Kinmen
popup.education.wholeVillageThis: Whole village belongs to this school
popup.education.sharedDistrictValue: ⚠️ This village also belongs to other schools (shared district)
popup.education.taipei110: Taipei City data is for the 2021–22 academic year (ROC 110)
popup.education.seniorNote: This layer shows county/city-level districts (15 nationwide), a different granularity from the village-level elementary and junior high school districts.
popup.education.cramNote: Cram school data is updated daily at the source; this is a snapshot from 2026-08-07
popup.education.noStudentNote: 21 of the 159 schools nationwide have no student count: 10 continuing-education colleges / the Open University (students counted under the parent school), 9 religious seminaries (outside Ministry of Education statistics), and 2 closed or renamed schools. This does not mean 0 students.
